verdict.rationale: Railway's built-in Railway Agent can act as an MCP client. Agent connectors let users add catalog integrations (Notion, Linear, Sentry) or point Railway at any remote MCP server, and the agent can then read from it while working on projects. However, the only evidence is a single docs line: it describes the agent reading from connected servers, it covers remote servers only, and it doesn't show full tool invocation or write actions. Railway's own MCP server (server role) is a separate capability and isn't credited here. Missing for 10: evidence that the agent can invoke arbitrary MCP tools beyond reading, local/stdio MCP server support, setup/auth and permission documentation for connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Connect Notion, Linear, or Sentry from the catalog, or point Railway at any remote MCP server you run, and the agent can read from it while it works on your projects.
The Railway Agent is a chat-based AI assistant built into the Railway dashboard.
